forecastNote: Working outlook based on the official North table, Explore’s 4–1 counting record, the commissioner’s six-game clarification, and confirmed match results. Exact league tiebreaks, bracket structure, and byes remain unconfirmed.
notes: All records on this page are shown as wins first, losses second.
Explore is 8 wins and 1 loss across all scheduled matches, but 4 wins and 1 loss in the six-game record used for playoff ranking.
Explore’s six official games are its five North opponents plus the assigned official crossover against Edison.
Only one Milestones meeting counts officially: the October 19 loss. The September 23 victory is part of the all-game record but not the playoff record.
CASA on November 9 is Explore’s sixth and final official ranking game.
The November 4 Sueño Park rematch was a 2–1 Explore victory and changes only the all-game record.
Top three from each division reach one combined six-team playoff.
The league has not published the bracket, byes, cross-division seeding, or tiebreak order.
The regular season is scheduled to end November 12, playoffs are scheduled for the week of November 16, and the championship is tentatively scheduled for Thursday, November 19 at ADP.
Explore’s known played-set record is 14 wins and 4 losses. The exact score from the second Scholars set remains unavailable, so the page does not invent a complete season point margin.
